unhappy.en: Tom said that he thought that Mary was unhappy in Boston.
unhappy.zh: 汤姆说他以为玛丽在波士顿不快乐。

upstairs.en: Go upstairs and bring down my trunk.
upstairs.zh: 上楼把我的旅行箱拿下来。

ugly.en: An ugly man knocked on my door.
ugly.zh: 一个丑男人敲了我的门。

upset.en: Don't get an upset stomach by eating too much.
upset.zh: 不要因为吃得太多而扰乱胃的正常消化。

unlucky.en: Four is an unlucky number in Japan.

used.en: The value of the coins depended on the weight of the metal used.
used.zh: 钱币的价值取决于所使用的金属的重量。

usual.en: At lunchtime today, our usual restaurant was closed because of a funeral in the family.
usual.zh: 今天午餐时间，我们常去的饭馆关门了，因为他们家在办丧事。

underwear.en: I am not wearing any underwear.

useful.en: The only useful answers are those that raise new questions.
useful.zh: 只有能提出新问题的回答才是有用的回答。

unfair.en: You should've rejected such an unfair proposal.
unfair.zh: 你本该拒绝一个那么不公平的提议。

unlikely.en: I know that it is highly unlikely that anyone would be willing to help me.
unlikely.zh: 我知道不太可能有人愿意帮助我。

unfortunately.en: Unfortunately, I have to get up early every morning.
unfortunately.zh: 不幸的是，我必须每天早起。

uncomfortable.en: I felt cold and uncomfortable the entire night.
uncomfortable.zh: 我整个晚上觉得又冷又不舒服。

unusual.en: We were faced with an unusual situation because of the accident.
unusual.zh: 那场事故让我们陷入了不寻常的局势。

university.en: The university was founded by his father twenty years ago.
university.zh: 大学在20年前由他的父亲建立。

unknown.en: The suspect's gender is currently unknown.

unable.en: We were unable to make contact with them until it was too late.
unable.zh: 我们联系上他们已经为时已晚。

unexpected.en: A little bit of luck sometimes leads to an unexpected success.
unexpected.zh: 一点点的运气有时会导致意想不到的成功。

uneasy.en: I understand that you feel uneasy, but don't worry.
uneasy.zh: 我知道你不自在，但别急。

urgent.en: If there's anything urgent, you can get in touch with me.
urgent.zh: 紧急情况下，您可以联系我。

unfit.en: He is unfit to be a teacher.

unnecessary.en: If two men always have the same opinion, one of them is unnecessary.
unnecessary.zh: 如果两个人总是意见相同，那么他们其中一个就没必要了。

unlike.en: The crane, unlike the dog, has never dreamed of flying.
unlike.zh: 不像狗, 这只鹤从来没有梦想过飞翔。

update.en: Tom needs to update his website.
update.zh: 汤姆需要更新他的网站。

unless.en: You don't have to go to the party unless you want to.
unless.zh: 除非你想去, 否则你不必去这个派对。

urban.en: More and more people are moving to urban areas.
urban.zh: 越来越多的人迁往市区。

unique.en: These flowers have a unique smell.
unique.zh: 这些花有一种独特的气味。

underneath.en: I found the key underneath the mat.
underneath.zh: 我在擦鞋垫下面发现了这把钥匙。

understanding.en: Tom and Mary came to an understanding.
understanding.zh: 汤姆和玛丽达成了协议。

unify.en: He tried to unify the various groups.
unify.zh: 他试著统一不同的团体。

upon.en: While we were discussing the problem, I hit upon a good idea.
upon.zh: 在我们讨论问题的过程中，我想到了一个好主意。

unpleasant.en: We had an unpleasant experience there.
unpleasant.zh: 我们在那里有一个不愉快的经历。

urge.en: Advertisements urge us to buy luxuries.
urge.zh: 广告怂恿我们买奢侈品。

ultraviolet.en: The ozone in the stratosphere absorbs ultraviolet radiation.
ultraviolet.zh: 平流层的臭氧会吸收紫外线。

utmost.en: This is a matter of the utmost importance.

ultimate.en: Our ultimate goal is to establish world peace.
ultimate.zh: 我们的究极目标是树立世界和平。

uncertain.en: Tom is still uncertain about whether to go to college or not.
uncertain.zh: 汤姆还不清楚要不要上大学。

unreasonable.en: There are always some people who are unreasonable.

union.en: The Cold War ended when the Soviet Union collapsed.

unconscious.en: He was discovered unconscious on the floor of the kitchen.
unconscious.zh: 他被人发现倒在厨房的地板上，不省人事。

universal.en: English is a universal language and is used all over the world.
universal.zh: 英语是一种世界性的语言，用于世界各地。

unemployment.en: The unemployment rate in Japan was 3.4 percent in September of 2015.
unemployment.zh: 在2015年9月日本的失业率为3.4％。

upper.en: Throughout the five years of painful cancer treatments, he managed to keep a stiff upper lip.
upper.zh: 这五年痛苦的癌症治疗他终于坚持下来了。
